title: Strict Kummer target and arbitrary-arrow reduction formula
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and invertible on an arbitrary scheme $W$, and let $D$ be a simultaneous derived reduction of scalar extension [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. There exist a strict constant $\mathbf Z_\ell$-module system $H$, an isomorphism of its underlying abelian tower with the actual roots tower [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], and $b:D.T(\mathbf G_m^{\mathrm{comp}}[1])\simeq H[2]$. At each level there is an isomorphism $t:H_n\simeq(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})(1)$ whose underlying map is the specified roots-to-line map. For any abelian sheaf $S$, normalized invertible source counit $a$, residue-module sheaf $Q$, source isomorphism $s:D.ordinary(S)_n\simeq\operatorname{Res}Q$, and $g:S\to\operatorname{forget}Q$ equal to the ordinary quotient scalar unit under $s$, every $f\in\operatorname{Ext}^1(S,\mathbf G_m^{\mathrm{comp}})$ has a residue-linear reduction $e\in\operatorname{Ext}^2(Q,(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})(1))$. Its scalar adjunct is $-f\kappa$, where $\kappa$ is the positive Kummer unit preceded by the units comparison [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data]. Restriction of $e$ to p-adic scalars equals evaluation of $a^{-1}D.T(f)b$ under $s,t$. This statement does not involve a Cartier divisor or prescribe a Cartier boundary. Canonical small Ext witnesses and additivity of scalar forgetting are provided by proved instances for the named sheaf structures; these transport the existing Cartier coefficient witnesses along definitional equalities. The Lean existence assertion is Nonempty of the explicitly defined strict target data structure; its fields are H, roots, b, the level isomorphisms and the two normalization/transport proofs. The type alias KummerStrictTarget chooses no object. Here kummerScalarAdjunct is exactly precomposition by the generator after the exact forgetful image of e; it and negativeExtProduct are real named expressions, not assumptions. The definition kummerRootNormalization is exactly the stated canonical underlying-map equation; it introduces no additional condition or chosen data.

source.place: Step (3), target paragraph (strict Kummer cohomology and transitions), and the naturality calculation of step (4), for arbitrary sources and degree-one maps rather than a Cartier boundary.

proof.text: Obtain H, its actual roots comparison, the strict target isomorphism b and all level maps t from strict Kummer adjunct compatibility. Retain its prescribed roots equations.

For arbitrary n,S,a,Q,s,g and f, apply the finite-arrow lifting theorem with the same a,b,s,t. It produces a residue-linear class e and exactly the required evaluation equation. This lifting step uses no Kummer data.

Apply the conditional Kummer adjunct equation to this e and its restriction equation. Pair that result with the symmetric restriction equation to establish KummerArrowTransport. Assemble all unchanged fields into KummerStrictTarget.

proof_origin.place: Steps (2)--(4): residue-linear existence separated from strict Kummer adjunct compatibility, then assembled in Lean by B6.

theorem kummer_strict_target_transport (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W)) :
    Nonempty (KummerStrictTarget ℓ W hW D)
